mapper.select: SELECT a.metadata_field_id AS metadataFieldId, mf.field_name AS fieldName, mf.field_code AS fieldCode, a.operator AS operator, a.attr_value AS attrValue, a.update_time AS updateTime FROM tab_app_access_policy_user_attr a INNER JOIN tab_metadata_field mf ON mf.id = a.metadata_field_id WHERE a.policy_id = #{policyId} ORDER BY a.id ASC
